_comment: One per environment (test, production). No secrets: delegated sign-in uses adminUpn; app-only uses a certificate in the Windows certificate store, named by thumbprint. Inputs resolve against this file's folder. Keep the filled copy inside the agency's boundary.
adminUpn: <read-only operator UPN, holding the read roles through PIM>

app.appId: <app-id, or leave as a placeholder for delegated sign-in>
